svg.title: conv_lab architecture
svg.desc: Four layers, each importing only the layers below it. Front ends (cli/ and the pytest regression) call Harness.run and receive a HarnessRun. harness.py validates the inputs, computes reference frames with core/, simulates with hardware/ when a QuestaTestbench is attached, checks DROP, and builds a RunComparison. hardware/ imports only kernels and images from core/, never the reference model or the comparison. hardware/contract.py writes stimulus.txt and parses features.txt in the run directory, and hardware/questa.py runs vlog and vsim, where conv_image_tb reads the stimulus, drives conv_system, and writes the features.
svg.text: sw/conv_lab · four layers, each importing only the layers below it · one run through Harness, numbered 1–5
EACH LAYER IMPORTS ONLY THE LAYERS BELOW
pytest · tests/unit/ has one file per module
the only module where the hardware side and the reference side meet
the only package that knows QuestaSim
pure Python · no simulator, no hardware imports
sw/.run, or a pytest tmp dir
core/ imports nothing else in conv_lab · hardware/ imports core/, but never reference or comparison
harness.py imports core/ and hardware/ · cli/ and the regression may import everything below them
